newsitem.title: GREECE: BAYERISCHE'S GEORGIOU TO HEAD EMERGING MARKETS TREASURY.
newsitem.headline: BAYERISCHE'S GEORGIOU TO HEAD EMERGING MARKETS TREASURY.

text.p: George Georgiou, the general manager of Bayerische Vereinsbank AG- Athens will be the new head of emerging markets in the treasury division of Bayerische Vereinsbank in Munich effective October 1, the bank said on Thursday.
In his new post, Georgiou, 43, will be coordinating all activities of the existing treasuries in the emerging markets of Athens, Prague and Warsaw.

"At the same time, Mr. Georgiou remains general manager of Bayerische Vereinsbank's Athens branch with the responsibility of the treasury," it said. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
